_comment: Configuration for the Bolster & Fortify three-closure pattern and station-sensitivity analysis (D:/projects/JT_reboot/src/features/regional-summary/bf-pattern-sensitivity-prompt.md). Every threshold/window/duration rule is read from this file and is copied verbatim from the reviewed internal/analysis/methodology_pilot/pilot_config.json in the sibling JT_exploration project - see bf_data.py / bf_sensitivity.py for the reuse mechanism (cross-project import, both are local sibling directories).

closure_1.label: Closure 1 (long closure)
closure_1.provenance: internal/analysis/bf_gate_event_scan/gate_event_assumptions.json (JT_exploration): E1_closure_start=2018-10-01 (simulation start, not shiftable), E1_reopen=2019-01-14 (last closed day ~2019-01-13). Inferred by visual inspection of the plotted gate-operation variable; +/-2 days uncertainty, but the closure-start transition is NOT shiftable (it coincides with simulation start, so there is no pre-closure comparison period).

closure_2.label: Closure 2 (short closure)
closure_2.provenance: internal/analysis/bf_gate_event_scan/gate_event_assumptions.json (JT_exploration): E2_closure_start=2019-11-26 (plot shows ~2019-11-26/27), E2_reopen=2019-12-11 (last closed day ~2019-12-10). Inferred by visual inspection; +/-2 days uncertainty on both transitions.

closure_3.label: Closure 3 (provisional)
closure_3.provenance: Visually inferred from the supplied gate-operation plot per the analysis prompt. No exact operational gate time series was found in either JT_reboot or JT_exploration (searched both projects for gate/closure CSV or JSON sources) - treated as provisional with the same +/-2 days uncertainty convention as closures 1 and 2, tested explicitly below.

franks_tract._note: Preserve the 9-station core as the current presentation reference (matches raw/franks-tract-sensitivity.csv's core_9 and the curated franks_tract_bf_2018_core9 pattern). Station 132 is NOT tested here (it belongs to Freshwater Corridor in this prompt, unlike the older franks-tract-sensitivity.csv which also tested a core_plus_132 variant).

north_franks_tract._note: Complete 16-station reviewed set, no station-membership search authorized - report station-level agreement and flag recurring dissenters only.

freshwater_corridor._note: The 4 authorized variants (core-only / core+355 / core+357 / complete) fall out directly from this 2-single-station-group setup.

clifton_court_forebay._note: 2^3=8 group-level combinations and the 7 individual-station leave-one-out tests are both produced by the full 2^7=128 combinatorial sweep over the 7 grouped stations.

labels.general_disclaimer: Exploratory Bolster & Fortify gate-closure pattern and station-sensitivity analysis. Not a regulatory compliance determination. Not reviewed or approved for the public interface. Language describes timing association only ("during the closure", "gate-associated timing") - never causal.
labels.sign_convention_label: Positive = Bolster & Fortify saltier (higher EC) than Business as Usual. Negative = Bolster & Fortify fresher (lower EC) than Business as Usual.
